title: kbmon shows the kb, coord and running sessions live and as one JSON snapshot
goal: kbmon.py prints one read-only snapshot of the kb, coord and running sessions as --json and --once text within a per-source timeout; the kb panel shows roots, articles, facts by tag, gaps, conflicts, refresh and census dates, eval status and index age; the coord panel shows live claims with time left, recent events, the intent digest and budgets against spend from a local store or a serve URL; the sessions panel shows Claude Code sessions, dispatch runs, worktrees with their branches, stalled items and orphans of this clone; the live view redraws in place with ANSI on macOS, Linux and Windows

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
